headline: Kenyan Court Freezes Assets in $11.5 Million Equity Bank Fraud Case
summary: Kenya's High Court has authorized Equity Bank to freeze accounts and crypto assets belonging to defendants involved in an $11.5 million fraud case, with a cap of $2.3 million.
why: Equity Bank is a major financial institution in East Africa. Legal actions involving fraud can impact investor sentiment and operational risk assessments for regional banks.
